notes.title: Plague Doctor - Small additions and bug fix
notes.content:
- Added 7 new intractable objects in chapter 1
- Fixed bug in chapter 1 where some interactions did not count towards goal

notes.title: Plague Doctor 1.3.0 (Exploration Patch 1)
notes.content:
Additions:
- Added 11 new objects to interact with and read new bits of story
- Added birds flying over docks/ new camera angle on chapter 2 intro

Changes / bug fixes:
- Reduce music volume for chapter 1 ending
- Fixed some inconsistent dialogue UI issues
- Fixed some graphical issues on ship

notes.title: Plague Doctor 1.2.3 (Minor Bug Fixes)
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed bug where after completing chapter 2, the stamp for having completed chapter 1 would be removed
- Fixed issue where some formatting code was mistakenly showing up in a dialogue button
- Changed sick sailor animation to prevent looking like doing sit-ups
- Changed ship Ensign dialogue to make conversation more clear
- Fixed bug where controls would only show up for a split second on chapter 2 start

Thanks so much to all the day one players, and launch weekend streamers!
- Alex
